title.en: Stone Fort on a Dirt Mound
title.es: Fuerte de piedra en un montículo de tierra
title.pt: Forte de pedra em um monte de terra

generated.description: A stone fort built on a tall dirt mound, with a grass top, cobblestone and stone brick walls, spruce plank towers and a few vines and iron bars. It stands about 35 by 35 blocks across and 100 blocks high, and includes a small hollow core with chests, signs, and a skull. The schematic is included with the source.
